environmentNotes: Device clock/timezone on the BrowserStack Pixel 7 is UTC (05:32 shown at 11:02 IST); 'today/now' defaults are evaluated against device time.

Viewport incidents: (1) ~05:44 UTC the App Live page viewport collapsed to 154x140 CSS px (window 1536x816) - resize_window did not help; user reset zoom (Ctrl+0). (2) ~05:49 UTC screenshots timed out again: tab visibilityState=hidden (window not in foreground). Recovery per new QA-RUN.md section 8 (viewport probe scripts/app-live-viewport-check.js). Environment issue - not an application defect.

Root cause of viewport collapses identified: the App Live tab runs in a separate Chrome window (Claude in Chrome tab group) that was minimised (screenX -25600, outer 160x28). Hidden tab -> screenshot/zoom timeouts -> timed-out zoom leaves viewport at zoom-region size. Environment/tooling issue, not an app defect.
Network simulation used: App Live Throttle Network > Offline Mode 08:47-08:51 UTC for TC_LOC_014 / TC_TRIP_009, then turned off.

INCIDENT - unintended irreversible action: Inquiry ID 506 (Local, Kempegowda Bus Station -> same, 30 Sep 2026 10:00 am, 4 hrs, 4 pax, 33 Seater Deluxe Coach, Rs 12,000) was submitted without approval at ~07:31 UTC. Cause: App Live stream froze (stale frames, network degradation before the 07:44 disconnect); the first Book Now tap opened Confirm Your Trip unseen and the repeated Book Now tap landed on the modal's Confirm button. Not cancelled (Cancel Trip requires user approval). Reported to the user. Prevention added to QA-RUN.md section 8.

Scope: 86 baseline Local Trip cases (HOME_004-027, 042; LOC_001-014; TRIP_001-007; VLIST_001-009; VDET_001-006, 009-013; CONF_001-010; INQ_001-010) + 7 new (HOME_043, 044, TRIP_008, 009, VLIST_010, VDET_015, 016) = 93. Cross-cutting cases touching Local (BOOK_003/004/010, NAV_003/005, NFR_001-005, 008, 009) were outside this run's scope and are not counted as covered.

Inventory gap review (proposed, NOT added - awaiting user approval of the diff per CLAUDE.md): (1) Local trip beyond 8Hr/80Km package applies Extra Hour/Extra Km charges in the estimate; (2) Night bata applied only when pickup/trip time falls in the night window; (3) Same search shows the same price on vehicle card, Vehicle Details and Confirm estimate (observed Rs 29,000 / Rs 10,000 / Rs 12,000); (4) Trip crossing midnight shows correct expected arrival/date; (5) Confirm Your Trip Confirm button sits where Book Now was - a repeated Book Now tap submits an inquiry (caused Inquiry 506).
